original_paragraph.Figure S5 caption: Figure S5. (A) ITC binding analysis of GID4 and 16. Kd represents the mean ± percent error while N, ΔH and ΔS values represent the mean ± SEM of determinations in duplicate. Representative profiles are shown from one experiment. (B) (top) Surface representation of GID4 in complex with 16 (PDB: 7U3I). (bottom) Unbiased density map (σ2) of 16. Residues 64, 213-218 and 247-250 are unmodeled due to ambiguous electron density.

original_paragraph.Figure S9 caption: Figure S9. (A) Fluorescence polarization binding experiment of GID4 wild-type (WT) or the GID4 mutant Q282A to a fluorescein-labeled PGLWKS peptide.
